definitions.explanation: A person employed by a company, typically as a regular full-time employee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{社員|しゃいん}だ。
examples.english: She is an employee of a large company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧{社員|しゃいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Training for new employees has begun.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I eat lunch at the employee cafeteria.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正|せい}{社員|しゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm aiming to be hired as a full-time employee.

notes:
{社員|しゃいん} combines ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company) + ⟦{員|いん}→〜員：01994_in⟧ (member).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}→新入：11503_shinnyuu⟧{社員|しゃいん} (new employee)
- ⟦{正|せい}{社員|しゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧ (regular/full-time employee)
- {社員|しゃいん}⟦{食堂|しょくどう}→食堂：01054_shokudou⟧ (employee cafeteria)
- {社員|しゃいん}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧ (company trip)
- {社員|しゃいん}⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧ (employee discount)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {社員|しゃいん}: company employee (general)
- ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧: office worker, company employee
- ⟦{従業員|じゅうぎょういん}→従業員：10018_juugyouin⟧: employee (more formal/general)
- ⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧: staff (from English)

USAGE:
- {社員|しゃいん} implies full-time regular employment
- Part-time workers are usually not called {社員|しゃいん}
